name: Brick-of-Bricks Decomposition
definition: A storage format where the volume is stored as a flat hierarchy of bricks of size n^3 to improve cache-coherence, derived from fully expanded octrees.
summary: Brick-of-Bricks Decomposition stores volumes as a flat hierarchy of n-cubed bricks to improve cache-coherence during raycasting, differing from fully expanded octrees by grouping voxels into contiguous blocks.
